cases.explain: «лживым языком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

cases.explain: «Тайный подарок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

cases.explain: «Лживый свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
